items.title: Claude Code Hacked to Achieve Full RCE and Hijacked Organization API keys
items.description: Critical vulnerabilities in Anthropic’s Claude Code, an AI-powered command-line development tool. The flaws could allow attackers to achieve Remote Code Execution (RCE) and exfiltrate Anthropic API keys by exploiting project configuration files. The issues were reported by Check Point Research (CPR), and Anthropic has fully patched all vulnerabilities prior to public disclosure. The…

items.title: 1 Million Records from Dutch Telco Odido Published Online After Extortion Attempt
items.description: A major data breach has hit Odido, one of the Netherlands’ prominent telecommunications providers, with cybercriminals publishing over one million customer records online following a failed extortion attempt in February 2026.
